subject: Subject: A front-facing, large, simple booking-confirmation interface panel, with a prominent green check mark and a small calendar illustration. This is the success state AFTER a booking has been sent. The result is clearly communicated, rather than asking for another confirmation. Exact Italian text, and ONLY this text: "Prenotazione" on one line and "ricevuta" on the next. Use a crisp bold dark-green sans-serif font resembling Inter, very large so the words remain readable at 250 px image display width. The check and text take most of the functional white surface. The panel can have a slim browser top strip with three tiny neutral dots but no other content. No primary action button, no unfinished form, no loading spinner, no error warning or additional text. No surrounding device, hand, person or room; focus entirely on the visible confirmation.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one standalone example illustration on a university slide explaining signifier, mapping and feedback. Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: reuse the precise editorial 2D contours, simplified forms, matte fills and pale green palette. Do not reuse people, tables, lettering or composition from the reference.
Landscape about 4:3; complete compact composition, generous transparent margins, readable when displayed at 250 x 180 px. Palette: Tailwind lime-950 #192E03 fine outlines, lime-800 #3C6300 structural details, lime-100 #ECFCCA and green-100 #DCFCE7 pale fills, opaque white functional surfaces, one lime-300 #BBF451 selection. Natural pale skin tone if a hand is present. Real alpha transparency outside the drawn objects. Clean flat fills, no texture, glow, shadows, 3D rendering, outer card, ornamental foliage, invented decorations, logos or watermark. Exact intentional geometry is important; objects must be fully visible.
